ControlDescription: Every governed CSV must exist and preserve its declared schema.
Every material evidence row must contain values for all declared fields.
Evidence identities must not be duplicated within a governed CSV.
The harness validates supplied evidence but does not invent observations, assessments, or outcomes.
Theorem scoring and disposition remain blocked until all required evidence files validate.
